text:
A fixed mass of air in a cylinder is compressed by a piston so that the volume of the air
decreases at constant temperature.
How do the air particles now collide with the cylinder walls?
A
less often with a greater velocity
B
less often with the same velocity
C
more often with a greater velocity
D
more often with the same velocity

options.label: A
options.text: less often with a greater velocity

options.label: B
options.text: less often with the same velocity

options.label: C
options.text: more often with a greater velocity

options.label: D
options.text: more often with the same velocity
